title: sealedDelta
responsibility: Verifies sealed device-chain extensions, opens missing grants and syncs scope object pages.

inputs.name: sealedReader.deviceId
inputs.description: Opaque public ID of the browser device enrolled in the account.

inputs.name: sealedReader.signal
inputs.description: Cancels in-flight requests when signed-in Home unmounts.

inputs.name: refreshSealedEnrollment.read
inputs.description: Same-origin sealed API request function bound to the browser device.

inputs.name: refreshSealedEnrollment.cache
inputs.description: IndexedDB cache handle bound to the signed-in account.

inputs.name: refreshSealedEnrollment.enrollment
inputs.description: This browser device and the signed chain entries used to verify its access.

inputs.name: refreshSealedEnrollment.pin
inputs.description: Previously verified device chain head and sequence number.

inputs.name: syncSealedObjects.read
inputs.description: Same-origin sealed API request function bound to the browser device.

inputs.name: syncSealedObjects.cache
inputs.description: IndexedDB cache handle bound to the signed-in account.

inputs.name: syncSealedObjects.scope
inputs.description: Opaque base64url scope ID from the signed device chain.

inputs.name: syncSealedObjects.keys
inputs.description: Non-extractable browser scope keys or the resolver for keys by envelope epoch.

outputs.name: sealedReader
outputs.description: An abortable same-origin GET client that supplies the public sealed device ID.

outputs.name: refreshSealedEnrollment
outputs.description: Latest verified chain and enrollment plus whether new scope keys were persisted.

outputs.name: syncSealedObjects
outputs.description: Resolves after committing the available object pages for the scope.

errors.name: SealedError
errors.description: The request failed, the chain failed authentication or did not advance, or an object did not match its listing and authenticated envelope.
